comment: The model of the Vulkan benchmark (the Llama 3.1 8B row of the README). The URL is pinned to a commit of the Hugging Face repository, so the file at that URL never changes; bytes and sha256 are those of the file (huggingface.co's own listing of that commit, and the file the spike measured). bench/vulkan/run.sh downloads it into the spike's cache/models folder when it is missing and refuses a file whose sha256 differs. The Qwen2.5 0.5B, 1.5B and 3B files of REPORT.md section 3 can be used the same way (see bench/vulkan/README.md); the 0.5B and 1.5B ones are in apps/local-llm/core/models.json.

models.name: Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
